caption: The drawing depicts a single, central object: a figurine of a woman standing with her hands clasped together in front of her chest. The figure has a long, dark blue or black cloak that covers her head and drapes down to the base, revealing only her face and front. Underneath the cloak, she wears a long, reddish-pink dress adorned with simple yellow decorative lines and patterns, with visible cracks and texture on the surface suggesting an aged or worn material. The woman's face is rendered with closed eyes and a solemn expression. The figurine stands on a round base shaded in dark gray and black tones. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are no other objects or decorative elements present. In the lower right part of the image, there is a faint signature.
title: Bulto
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
